WEBVTT

00:00:01.000 --> 00:00:09.000
<v Sarah Lin>Hi everyone, let's plan the mobile release. Raj, where are we on PROJ-720, the offline sync feature?

00:00:09.500 --> 00:00:18.000
<v Raj Mehta>PR #512 is open on github.com/contoso/mobile-app and it's ready for review. Nina, could you review it by Friday?

00:00:18.500 --> 00:00:22.000
<v Nina Kowalski>Yes, I'll review PR #512 by Friday.

00:00:22.500 --> 00:00:31.000
<v Sarah Lin>Great. We've decided to ship the release on June 29th instead of the 25th, to give beta testers a full week.

00:00:31.500 --> 00:00:40.000
<v Nina Kowalski>That works for me. One blocker though, I'm waiting on the updated app store screenshots from the design team before I can finalize the listing.

00:00:40.500 --> 00:00:47.000
<v Raj Mehta>I'll chase the design team for the screenshots and get them to you by Wednesday.

00:00:47.500 --> 00:00:58.000
<v Sarah Lin>Thanks. The release checklist is on SharePoint at https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/Mobile/Shared%20Documents/Release-Checklist-v7.docx, please go through it before the 29th.

00:00:58.500 --> 00:01:03.000
<v Raj Mehta>Will do. I'll also loop in priya.kapoor@contoso.com since she owns the beta program.

00:01:03.500 --> 00:01:13.000
<v Carlos Ferreira>Hi all, Carlos from the QA vendor side. Quick question, does the offline sync need to work on Android 11, or can we drop support for it this release?

00:01:13.500 --> 00:01:19.000
<v Sarah Lin>Good question, let me confirm the minimum Android version with product and get back to you.

00:01:19.500 --> 00:01:28.000
<v Nina Kowalski>Also flagging a risk, the offline sync could double our storage usage on older devices if we don't add a cache cap.

00:01:28.500 --> 00:01:33.000
<v Sarah Lin>Good catch, let's add a cache cap to the scope before we ship.

00:01:33.500 --> 00:01:38.000
<v Raj Mehta>Agreed. I'll write up the cache cap requirement and share it today.
